description: Quick add (PL-022) read the same in the app and on the server (PL-137). Each case is one line of text and what it becomes: the title left over, the tokens recognised (where they sit), the start and end, the due date, priority, list, tags (an existing one by id, a new one by name), assignees and the repeat rule. The web suite runs these through parseQuickAdd with chrono; the server suite through its C# port. The reference is the person's wall clock: Wednesday 2026-10-21 10:00. Only forms both sides read belong here; a phrase only chrono knows stays in the title on the server.
